##### Project general facts

Sobha Verde is a premium residential development by Sobha Realty, a pioneer in the real estate industry known for its backward integration model and unwavering commitment to quality. This tower offers one to three-and-a-half-bedroom apartments, each designed to resonate with your aura and celebrate your arrival. With its striking façade of geometry and magnificent windows, Sobha Verde redefines contemporary sophistication, offering a home that marks your presence and becomes a befitting legacy for discerning residents.

Residents enjoy a wealth of premium amenities designed to enhance every aspect of daily life. A stunning swimming pool offers a warm embrace to soothe your senses, while a state-of-the-art fitness center helps you reach your best form. A thoughtfully designed lounge sets the mood for barbeque parties under a starlit sky, and a dedicated play area provides the perfect space for laughter and connection. A rooftop lounge offers a place of lavish leisure with soft cushions and cool breeze, where you can immerse yourself in rooftop delights to renew your emotional fortitude.

Every residence at Sobha Verde features modern finishing with high-quality materials, fully equipped kitchens, and thoughtfully designed layouts that maximize space and natural light. The elegant living rooms observe the brilliance of natural light orchestrating new harmony through glazed windows, while bespoke chambers offer stunning views of the starry sky. The spacious abodes are designed to accommodate all those created memories with loved ones, with quiet quarters for moments of mindfulness and introspection. Every detail reflects Sobha Realty's passion for perfectionism and commitment to raising the benchmark of the real estate segment.

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled in Jumeirah Lake Towers, a unique neighbourhood that offers something for everyone, this exceptional location provides residents with a new kind of living in an eclectic universe. From thriving business parks to community living, scintillating restaurants to five-star hotels, high street to haute couture brands, and pristine parks to professional pitches, everything is within a short distance.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity to key destinations. Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Harbour, Dubai Marina, JBR Beach, Marina Mall, Ain Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, Mall of the Emirates, Madinat Jumeirah, and Burj Al Arab are all within easy reach. The breath-taking views of the vast meadows and jade green golf course leave a lingering feeling of serenity throughout the day.

For those seeking a residence that embodies urban luxury, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Lake Towers delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of diverse amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can discover a new kind of living.
